name: Shethar Boznai
overview: Shethar Boznai appears in the book of Ezra as an official serving under the Persian king, working alongside Tatnai, the governor on this side of the river. He is involved in overseeing the rebuilding of the temple in Jerusalem, questioning who authorized the construction (Ezra 5:3), communicating with King Darius through official letters (Ezra 5:6), and carrying out the king's commands swiftly (Ezra 6:13). These passages highlight Shethar Boznai's role as a governmental authority ensuring that the king's orders regarding the temple's reconstruction were followed.
